sentences.en: The ad is causing rifts, even within the Republican Party.

sentences.en: You're wondering what Vice President J.D.

sentences.en: Vann thinks about that ad in the Ohio governor's race.
sentences.zh: 万斯对俄亥俄州州长竞选中那则广告有什么看法。

sentences.en: Over the past few days, the background noise of this fall's midterm elections, campaign advertising, exploded into public consciousness
sentences.zh: 在过去几天里，今年秋季中期选举的背景噪音——竞选广告，彻底爆发并进入了公众视野，

sentences.en: because of a highly controversial TV commercial in Ohio, which highlighted the two very different stories that Democratic and Republican candidates across the country are telling
sentences.zh: 因为俄亥俄州有一则极具争议的电视广告，它凸显了全国各地的民主党和共和党候选人

sentences.en: in the final days of campaigning.
sentences.zh: 在竞选的最后几天里正在讲述的两个截然不同的故事。

sentences.en: Today, national political correspondent Shane Goldmacher takes us inside the most expensive midterm ad campaign in American history.
sentences.zh: 今天，国家政治记者肖恩·戈尔德马赫将带我们深入了解美国历史上最昂贵的中期选举广告战。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月26日，星期一。

sentences.en: Shane, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 肖恩，欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

sentences.en: So I have a question for you.
sentences.zh: 所以我有个问题想问你。

sentences.en: In your role as national political correspondent, how many campaign ads do you estimate that you have watched for this midterm election?
sentences.zh: 作为国家政治记者，你估计自己为了这次中期选举看了多少条竞选广告？

sentences.en: Just give me a number.
sentences.zh: 给我个数字就行。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Hundreds.
sentences.zh: 几百条。

sentences.en: Yeah, hundreds and hundreds of TV ads.
sentences.zh: 对，几百上千条电视广告。

sentences.en: I am the person who has voluntarily signed up to get every new television ad in every congressional race emailed to me.
sentences.zh: 我就是那种自愿注册、要求把国会选举中每一个新电视广告都发到我邮箱里的人。

sentences.en: What does that even look like?
sentences.zh: 那到底是个什么场景？

sentences.en: It looks like an obliteration of my inbox.
sentences.zh: 那就像是我的收件箱被彻底摧毁了。

sentences.en: You get every single ad that runs anywhere in these midterms directly sent to you.
sentences.zh: 所有在这次中期选举中任何地方播出的广告都会直接发送给你。

sentences.en: In House and Senate races.
sentences.zh: 众议院和参议院的竞选广告都有。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean I'm watching all of them, but I will at the end of many days take a chunk of time
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着我把它们全看了，但在很多天结束时，我会抽出一大段时间

sentences.en: to just sit for 40 minutes and suffer through what the parties are putting on television.
sentences.zh: 坐上40分钟，默默忍受各政党在电视上播放的内容。

sentences.en: So just unwind with campaign.
sentences.zh: 所以就是靠竞选广告来放松。

sentences.en: Just unwind with an end of the day.
sentences.zh: 就是靠结束一天的活动来放松。

sentences.en: Unwind with like a brewski and a series of attack ads.
sentences.zh: 配上一杯啤酒和一系列攻击性广告来放松。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's a masochiSt.
sentences.zh: 这真是个受虐狂。

sentences.en: That's life.
sentences.zh: 这就是生活。

sentences.en: So just explain why you spend so much of your time doing that.
sentences.zh: 那么请解释一下，你为什么花那么多时间做这件事。

sentences.en: And we've talked about this a little bit through various campaigns, but I think it bears repeating.
sentences.zh: 我们在之前的各种竞选中也聊过一点，但我认为这值得重申。

sentences.en: Why you dwell in the land and sometimes the sewer of American campaign advertising so meaningfully?
sentences.zh: 为什么你要如此意味深长地栖身于美国竞选广告的这片土地、有时甚至是粪坑之中？

sentences.en: I just think that campaigns spend an enormous amount of time thinking about what they're going to put in these ads.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得竞选团队花了大量时间思考要在这些广告里放些什么。

sentences.en: They spend the majority of their money on digital and television ads.
sentences.zh: 他们把大部分资金都花在了数字和电视广告上。

sentences.en: That is how they communicate to people.
sentences.zh: 那是他们与人们沟通的方式。

sentences.en: And that is the greatest distillation of what they think is their message and can help them win.
sentences.zh: 那是他们对自认为的能帮助他们获胜的信息的最佳提炼。

sentences.en: You can tell when somebody goes negative what that means.
sentences.zh: 当某人开始搞负面攻击时，你可以看出这意味着什么。

sentences.en: You can tell what issues are resonating and it changes, right?
sentences.zh: 你可以看出哪些议题引起了共鸣，而且这会变，对吧？

sentences.en: The tenor, the topics of the ads change from cycle to cycle.
sentences.zh: 广告的基调和主题在不同的选举周期中会发生变化。

sentences.en: You can see a campaign get more desperate over weeks and months as they go more negative.
sentences.zh: 随着攻击越来越负面，你会在几周和几个月内看到一个竞选团队变得越来越绝望。

sentences.en: When somebody starts negative, maybe they're behind.
sentences.zh: 当某人以负面攻击开局时，也许他们落后了。

sentences.en: You learn so much just by watching.
sentences.zh: 光是看着，你就能学到很多东西。

sentences.en: You call a lot of people, talk to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 你会给很多人打电话，跟很多人交谈。

sentences.en: That's important too, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显然，这也很重要。

sentences.en: But this sort of sets the mood music of the entire election for me.
sentences.zh: 但这对我来说有点像是为整场选举定下了情绪基调。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's an x-ray, I think you've said to me in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 就像是一张X光片，我想你过去也对我说过。

sentences.en: Campaign ads are an x-ray that doesn't lie of what campaigns are hopeful of and worried about and what they think the electorate is up to.
sentences.zh: 竞选广告是一张不会说谎的X光片，展现了竞选团队充满希望和担忧的事情，以及他们对选民意图的看法。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you have to remember that these TV ads are the chance that candidates have and super PACs have to introduce themselves to the most important set of voters,
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，这些电视广告是候选人和超级政治行动委员会向最重要的一群选民介绍他们自己的机会，

sentences.en: which is people who don't actually want to pay attention to the campaign, people who are too busy working, too busy living their life, or apathetic about politics.
sentences.zh: 这群人就是那些实际上不想关注竞选的人，那些忙于工作、忙于生活或者对政治冷漠的人。

sentences.en: So campaigns spend an enormous amount of money and energy figuring out what is the one message that you can force feed somebody while watching football,
sentences.zh: 因此，竞选团队花费了巨额资金和精力来研究，在人们观看橄榄球比赛时，能强行塞给他们什么样唯一的信息，

sentences.en: make them suffer through on YouTube pre-roll, that introduces your candidate, says, hey, I'm a different kind of Democrat, or I'm a different kind of Republican,
sentences.zh: 让他们在YouTube的前贴片广告中忍受痛苦，以此来介绍你的候选人，说：嘿，我是个不同寻常的民主党人，或者我是个不同寻常的共和党人，

sentences.en: or says, I'm the guy who's going to cut your taxes, the gal who's going to cut your costs.
sentences.zh: 或者说：我就是那个要为你减税的伙计，那个要为你削减生活成本的姑娘。

sentences.en: You know, picking which one thing you want to emphasize for those disengaged voters.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是为那些不关心政治的选民挑选一件你想强调的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Who in many, many races become decisive, especially in a lot of the tight, tight races that we've been talking about with you, with our colleagues throughout these midterMs.
sentences.zh: 他们在许多许多竞选中变得具有决定性作用，特别是在我们与你、与我们的同事在整个中期选举中一直在讨论的那些极其激烈的选民竞争中。

sentences.en: So, let's talk about the stories that both parties are telling in this midterm election, especially in this frantic last week or so of this election,
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们来聊聊两党在这次中期选举中讲述的故事，特别是在这次选举疯狂的最后一周左右的时间里，

sentences.en: and let's start with the story that the Democrats have been telling in these ads.
sentences.zh: 让我们从民主党在这些广告中讲述的故事开始。

sentences.en: I think that the story the Democrats are telling is pretty simple.
sentences.zh: 我认为民主党讲述的故事非常简单。

sentences.en: They're trying to fill in for voters the story of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们试图为选民补全唐纳德·特朗普的故事。

sentences.en: Are you better off now than you were a few years ago?
sentences.zh: 你现在的生活比几年前过得更好吗？

sentences.en: So, there's one path to saving America.
sentences.zh: 因此，拯救美国只有一条途径。

sentences.en: Elect enough Democrats to Congress to stop Trump.
sentences.zh: 在国会选出足够多的民主党人来阻止特朗普。

sentences.en: The president typically is the lead driver of every election, of midterm elections in particular, and he's unpopular.
sentences.zh: 总统通常是每场选举、特别是中期选举的主要驱动力，而他并受欢迎。

sentences.en: And they're trying to tell the audience why.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图向观众解释原因。

sentences.en: Trump's war abroad costs taxpayers a billion dollars a day on a war we have no business fighting.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在海外的战争每天都在消耗纳税人十亿美元，打一场我们根本不该插手的战争。

sentences.en: Our schools crumble, our factories shudder, our gas prices skyrocket.
sentences.zh: 我们的学校在坍塌，我们的工厂在倒闭，我们的油价在飙升。

sentences.en: And they're telling a story that Trump made promises of change to improve the economy, to lower prices, and telling how and why he failed.
sentences.zh: 他们讲述这样一个故事：特朗普曾许下变革的承诺以改善经济、降低物价，并讲述了他如何以及为什么失败了。

sentences.en: It's a story that includes tariffs in some places, the war in Iran in other places, the cost of living.
sentences.zh: 这是一个包含某些地方的关税、其他地方对伊朗的战争以及生活成本的故事。

sentences.en: The endless war in Iran is costing us all.
sentences.zh: 伊朗旷日持久的战争让我们付出了代价。

sentences.en: Billions for bombs.
sentences.zh: 成亿的资金用于炸弹。

sentences.en: Brutal at our gas pumps.
sentences.zh: 对我们的加油站来说是残酷的打击。

sentences.en: There's an entire genre of Democratic ads this year, of Democratic candidates standing at a gas station pumping gas, or in particular, Democrats standing in a grocery store saying,
sentences.zh: 今年有一大类民主党广告，讲的是民主党候选人站在加油站加油，或者特别是民主党人站在杂货店里说，

sentences.en: Donald Trump failed you.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普辜负了你们。

sentences.en: And that is why these groceries are so expensive.
sentences.zh: 这就是这些杂货如此昂贵的原因。

sentences.en: That is why this regular fuel costs five, six dollars a gallon.
sentences.zh: 这就是普通燃油价格高达五六美元一加仑的原因。

sentences.en: And it's a pretty simple story to tell.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当简单的故事。

sentences.en: Donald Trump promised no new wars.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普承诺不发动新的战争。

sentences.en: Instead, there's a war in Iran, and people see the direct link between that war and these price increases.
sentences.zh: 然而，伊朗却爆发了一场战争，人们看到了这场战争与物价上涨之间的直接联系。

sentences.en: Someone you just interviewed, James Tallarico, the Democratic— You do listen to the show.
sentences.zh: 你刚才采访的人，詹姆斯·塔拉里科，这位民主党人——你还真听这个节目啊。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我听的。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我听的。

sentences.en: The single most expensive ad that he's put money behind this cycle features basically all of the above.
sentences.zh: 他在这个选举周期砸钱支持的最昂贵的一则广告基本上包含了上述所有内容。

sentences.en: I'm James Tallarico.
sentences.zh: 我是詹姆斯·塔拉里科。

sentences.en: In the statehouse, I brought both parties together to make life more affordable.
sentences.zh: 在议会里，我让两党走到一起，让生活变得更加负担得起。

sentences.en: In this ad, he starts in a grocery store holding a brown bag of groceries, and he tips through all the things that now cost too much.
sentences.zh: 在这则广告中，他从一家杂货店开始，手里提着一袋棕色的杂货，数着所有现在变得太昂贵的东西。

sentences.en: Too many Texans feel like they're drowning.
sentences.zh: 太多的德克萨斯人觉得自己快要被淹没了。

sentences.en: The cost of groceries, gas, health care.
sentences.zh: 杂货、汽油、医疗保健的成本。

sentences.en: Then he makes his way to his car, a reminder of gas, and says, we're going to try to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 然后他走向他的车，这是对汽油的提醒，并说道，我们要努力削减成本。

sentences.en: Elect me.
sentences.zh: 选我吧。

sentences.en: That's what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我要做的。

sentences.en: I approve this message because it shouldn't be this hard to keep your head above water.
sentences.zh: 我批准这条信息，因为维持生计不该这么艰难。

sentences.en: And I think what it's trying to tap into is the broad sense that people feel like they're falling behind and somebody, the elites, are getting ahead.
sentences.zh: 我认为它试图触及的是一种普遍感受，即人们觉得自己正在落后，而某些人、也就是精英阶层正在领先。

sentences.en: And when Democrats are talking about cost of living, they apply it to a huge range of things.
sentences.zh: 当民主党人在谈论生活成本时，他们将其应用到了范围极广的事物上。

sentences.en: There have been a number of ads about drugs and drug pricing in particular.
sentences.zh: 已经有很多关于药品特别是药品定价的广告了。

sentences.en: And so in Iowa, Democrats are running against Ashley Hinson, who's a congresswoman.
sentences.zh: 因此在艾奥瓦州，民主党人正在与身为国会议员的阿什利·辛森竞选。

sentences.en: Josh Turk is the Democratic nominee.
sentences.zh: 乔希·特克是民主党候选人。

sentences.en: And a super PAC supporting him has an ad filmed in a drugstore with a series of people basically saying,
sentences.zh: 支持他的一个超级政治行动委员会制作了一则在药店拍摄的广告，片中有一连串的人基本上在说，

sentences.en: It's all more expensive.
sentences.zh: 一切都更贵了。

sentences.en: Way more expensive because of Ashley Hinson.
sentences.zh: 因为阿什利·辛森，贵得离谱。

sentences.en: Things are more expensive because of Ashley Hinson.
sentences.zh: 因为阿什利·辛森，东西更贵了。

sentences.en: Ashley Hinson took over $160,000 from drug companies.
sentences.zh: 阿什利·辛森从制药公司收了超过16万美元。

sentences.en: Then she voted to raise our prices.
sentences.zh: 然后她投票赞成提高我们的价格。

sentences.en: And they tie her to campaign contributions that she's taken, votes that she's taken, and saying she's the reason you pay so much when you go to the drugstore.
sentences.zh: 他们将她与她收受的竞选捐款、她投过的票联系起来，并声称她就是你去药店时花那么多钱的原因。

sentences.en: She sold us out before and she'll sell us out again.
sentences.zh: 她以前出卖了我们，还会再次出卖我们。

sentences.en: And so what that anti-Hinson ad is doing is something that Democrats are doing all across the country in a lot of different races.
sentences.zh: 所以，这则反辛森的广告所做的事情，正是民主党人在全国各地许多不同竞中所做的事情。

sentences.en: And that is directly tying accusations of corruption,
sentences.zh: 那就是直接将腐败的指控，

sentences.en: Republican corruption, to your personal cost of living.
sentences.zh: 共和党的腐败，与你的个人生活成本联系起来。

sentences.en: Say more about that.
sentences.zh: 再多讲讲这个。

sentences.en: I mean, it's not the most intuitive thing, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这并不是最直观的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: People think about corruption and maybe somebody's buying and selling some president or lawmaker in Washington.
sentences.zh: 人们想到腐败，可能会想到有人在华盛顿买卖某个总统或议员。

sentences.en: And making the person who benefits from it rich.
sentences.zh: 并让从中受益的人变得富有。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the idea is tapping into people's sense that they are falling behind and someone else, the elites, not them, is getting ahead.
sentences.zh: 这个想法触及了人们的一种感觉，即他们正在落后，而其他人、即精英阶层而不是他们，正在领先。

sentences.en: And you see this in a slew of different spaces where Democrats are saying, this Republican in Congress is getting rich.
sentences.zh: 你可以在许多不同的领域看到这一点，民主党人在说，国会里的这个共和党人正在变得富有。

sentences.en: And you, dear person watching this ad unwillingly, you're getting poorer, that your spending power is going down.
sentences.zh: 而你，亲爱的、不情愿地看着这个广告的人，你却在变穷，你的购买力在下降。

sentences.en: And you have someone to blame.
sentences.zh: 你得怪某个人。

sentences.en: It's the people in power.
sentences.zh: 就是当权者。

sentences.en: Pick us.
sentences.zh: 选我们吧。

sentences.en: Try something new.
sentences.zh: 尝试点新东西。
